question: Should selected Discord role mentions become supported multi-agent wake targets, and should the permanent config be a narrow trigger-role list or part of the broader role-aware access-list redesign?
rationale: Current broad role activation was previously treated as a design choice, while the requested behavior adds configuration and multi-agent amplification semantics that source inspection cannot resolve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add selected trigger roles
options.body: Add an additive guild/channel role-ID trigger list while preserving existing sender `roles` access semantics.

options.title: Use access-list redesign
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/69748 canonical and incorporate mentioned-role wake semantics into that broader model.

options.title: Keep direct targeting
options.body: Decline selected role fan-out and preserve current direct-bot and mass-mention behavior.

recommendation.title: Add selected trigger roles
recommendation.body: Add an additive guild/channel role-ID trigger list while preserving existing sender `roles` access semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current mention policy and have the strongest history-backed connection to this behavior choice.
